name: mcp-ptitchef
description: MCP server for Ptitchef. Browse the recipe category tree and read its recipes. No API key required.
long_description: Ptitchef browses its recipes by a tree of ingredient families, and every category is addressed by a slug the site writes freely: the same ingredient appears as 'chou-kale' on one line and as 'recette-de-petits-pois' on the next. A slug built by hand therefore reaches a page the site does not hold, which a caller reads as the site holding no such recipes. This server publishes the tree instead, so a category is opened by the name the site gave it. Every answer states what the page listed beside what it rendered, and the entries the site shows beside a family are marked as the excerpt the site prints them to be. Read-only, no API key and no account.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List the categories recipes are browsed by: the families of ingredients, or what one family holds, each with the slug that opens it.
